title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Latest RemoteOK inventory validated for target-family scope and Canadian regional eligibility. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.

notes_sections.heading: Regional exclusions
items: Engineering Manager/TLM, Platform — Harper (posted September 11): the role owns infrastructure, developer productivity, SRE, and production support, but requires relocation to San Francisco and attendance in the office five days each week. It was not scored. View posting.

notes_sections.heading: Scope exclusions
items: Software Engineer — Mirantis (posted September 12): worldwide, but the disclosed position is Golang product engineering rather than SRE, Platform, DevOps, or infrastructure automation.
The other 97 API jobs were unrelated roles such as sales, finance, customer support, application development, data engineering, and general operations.

notes_sections.heading: Search limitations
items: The refreshed public API again returned 99 job objects; 20 were dated within the preferred 14-day window.
The API is a latest-inventory feed rather than a dedicated keyword-search endpoint. The full returned inventory was reviewed for target titles, tags, and description signals.
No eligible, unclear, inaccessible, stale, or known-pipeline target-family role surfaced. No CAPTCHA, verification page, or write-side action occurred.
